'''Kean Ma'Sheavor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Dread War]], he was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]'s surface as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] specializing in captured goods for [[Strike Team Oricon]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kean Ma'Sheavor was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. He serves as the Reputation Vendor for Strike Team Oricon, the Republic version of the reputation group on Oricon.<ref name="TOR" />
